title: Electroweak mixing and the W-to-Z mass relation from complete Fold channels
description:
Read the full paper (PDF)

Complete Fold channels derive an exact terminal on-shell electroweak share and its W-to-Z squared-mass complement, passing both registered physical comparisons.

Maria Smith derives all 225 charged and 784 neutral labelled channels from the four-rung electromagnetic promotion object. Sixteen binary words and three held generator directions force level thirteen; the full channel share is 225/1009 and one terminal return contributes alpha/17. The exact result is 1930922298157999/8642477221479757, with a positive complement that partitions One.

The paper includes the full Fold-preimage census, general support/product completeness and uniqueness proofs, arbitrary positive rational common-unit cancellation, all intermediate mathematics, exhaustive 256- and 1024-form grammars, and native Lean proof references. Every original measured row and uncertainty is retained, including the separately typed all-input aggregation record and both altered-record controls.

The archive provides pinned V3/V4 sources, original build and empty-axiom audit evidence, complete program and observation comparisons, and portable exact-arithmetic reproduction. Scientific author: Maria Smith, Ernos Labs.
